reason: A local visual companion that renders an evolving pet based on agent session signals, displays working state, and creates growth-card images.

summaries.zh: 一个根据智能体会话信号展示状态并逐步进化宠物形象、同时生成成长卡片图片的本地可视化插件。
summaries.en: A local visualization plugin that shows an evolving pet based on agent session signals and generates growth-card images.

capabilities: Reads local session logs and rule files specified by the user
Runs a local web server for the pet interface
Generates PNG growth cards in the browser
Processes local agent session signals such as completion, tool calls, and compaction events
